core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khalisah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pure, sincere”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khalisah corresponds to the Arabic form خالصة (Arabic root خ ل ص (kh-l-ṣ); خَالِصَة (Khāliṣa)). Its core sense is pure, sincere (feminine). Khalisah is Arabic خَالِصَة (Khāliṣa) 'pure, sincere' (feminine), from the root خ ل ص (kh-l-ṣ). The source gloss 'Pure, Clean' is broadly consistent. Same name as khalisa.

arabic.name: خالصة
